sentences.pt: Eduardo herdou do tio um boteco antigo numa esquina de Belo Horizonte.
sentences.en: Eduardo inherited an old neighborhood bar on a corner in Belo Horizonte from his uncle.

sentences.pt: Durante quarenta anos, o lugar foi famoso pelos tira-gostos e pela cerveja sempre gelada.
sentences.en: For forty years, the place was famous for its bar snacks and its always ice-cold beer.

sentences.pt: Mas, quando Eduardo começou a cuidar do lugar, percebeu que quase tudo na cozinha era industrializado.
sentences.en: But when Eduardo started running the place, he noticed that almost everything in the kitchen was industrially made.

sentences.pt: O presunto vinha em embalagens de plástico, o molho vinha pronto, e a batata frita chegava congelada.
sentences.en: The ham came in plastic packaging, the sauce came ready-made, and the French fries arrived frozen.

sentences.pt: Ele leu as embalagens e ficou assustado com a quantidade de conservantes.
sentences.en: He read the packaging and was alarmed by the amount of preservatives.

sentences.pt: Eduardo tinha estudado gastronomia e sonhava com uma cozinha de verdade.
sentences.en: Eduardo had studied gastronomy and dreamed of a real kitchen.

sentences.pt: Decidiu, então, trocar os alimentos ultraprocessados por comida feita ali mesmo.
sentences.en: So he decided to replace the ultra-processed foods with food made right there.

sentences.pt: Foi procurar fornecedores na zona rural, a duas horas da cidade.
sentences.en: He went looking for suppliers in the countryside, two hours from the city.

sentences.pt: Lá conheceu Dona Lúcia, que planta legumes orgânicos sem nenhum agrotóxico.
sentences.en: There he met Mrs. Lúcia, who grows organic vegetables without any pesticide.

sentences.pt: Ela cultivava tudo à mão, como a mãe e a avó dela tinham feito.
sentences.en: She grew everything by hand, as her mother and grandmother had done.

sentences.pt: "Minha safra depende da chuva, meu filho", avisou ela. "Tem mês que tem muito, tem mês que não tem nada."
sentences.en: "My harvest depends on the rain, my son," she warned. "Some months there's a lot, some months there's nothing."

sentences.pt: Eduardo achou que conseguiria lidar com isso.
sentences.en: Eduardo thought he could handle that.

sentences.pt: Os primeiros meses foram um sucesso.
sentences.en: The first months were a success.

sentences.pt: Os pratos eram simples, mas tinham sabor de comida de casa.
sentences.en: The dishes were simple, but they tasted like home cooking.

sentences.pt: Os clientes adoravam o frango grelhado, a batata crocante e o caldo de feijão temperado na hora.
sentences.en: The customers loved the grilled chicken, the crispy potatoes and the bean broth seasoned on the spot.

sentences.pt: Em agosto, no entanto, veio a seca.
sentences.en: In August, however, the drought came.

sentences.pt: A escassez de chuva acabou com metade da safra, e o abastecimento virou um problema.
sentences.en: The lack of rain wiped out half the harvest, and the supply became a problem.

sentences.pt: Algumas semanas, faltava tomate; em outras, faltava cebola.
sentences.en: Some weeks, there were no tomatoes; in others, there were no onions.

sentences.pt: Além disso, os legumes orgânicos são perecíveis e não duram muitos dias na geladeira.
sentences.en: Besides, organic vegetables are perishable and don't last many days in the fridge.

sentences.pt: O cozinheiro, Seu Antônio, que trabalhava ali havia vinte anos, ficou irritado.
sentences.en: The cook, Mr. Antônio, who had worked there for twenty years, got irritated.

sentences.pt: "Com o seu tio, nunca faltava nada!", reclamou ele.
sentences.en: "With your uncle, we never ran out of anything!" he complained.

sentences.pt: Eduardo pensou em voltar atrás, mas teve outra ideia.
sentences.en: Eduardo thought about backing down, but had another idea.

sentences.pt: Em vez de um cardápio que nunca muda, o boteco passaria a ter um quadro com os pratos do dia.
sentences.en: Instead of a menu that never changes, the bar would start having a board with the dishes of the day.

sentences.pt: Se tivesse cenoura, haveria sopa de cenoura; se tivesse tomate, haveria frango com molho de tomate.
sentences.en: If there were carrots, there would be carrot soup; if there were tomatoes, there would be chicken in tomato sauce.

sentences.pt: Seu Antônio ficou cético, mas aos poucos começou a gostar de criar pratos novos.
sentences.en: Mr. Antônio was skeptical, but little by little he started to enjoy creating new dishes.

sentences.pt: Os clientes também mudaram e passaram a perguntar, logo na porta: "O que tem hoje?"
sentences.en: The customers changed too and started asking, right at the door: "What's on today?"

sentences.pt: Hoje, o boteco do Eduardo vive lotado nos fins de semana.
sentences.en: Today, Eduardo's bar is always packed on weekends.

sentences.pt: E a cerveja, claro, continua gelada como no tempo do tio.
sentences.en: And the beer, of course, is still as cold as in his uncle's time.

questions.q: O que Eduardo não gostou na cozinha do tio?
questions.qEn: What did Eduardo not like about his uncle's kitchen?

questions.q: Qual foi o problema em agosto?
questions.qEn: What was the problem in August?
How did Eduardo solve the problem?
options: Criou um cardápio que muda a cada dia

sentences.pt: Todo ano, no aniversário da avó, a família inteira se encontra em Recife para um almoço enorme.
sentences.en: Every year, on grandma's birthday, the whole family meets in Recife for a huge lunch.

sentences.pt: O prato principal é sempre o mesmo: um feijão com carne que a avó faz desde a juventude.
sentences.en: The main dish is always the same: a beans-and-meat stew that grandma has been making since her youth.

sentences.pt: Este ano, porém, a neta Beatriz chegou com uma notícia.
sentences.en: This year, however, her granddaughter Beatriz arrived with some news.

sentences.pt: "Avó, eu virei vegana", disse ela, um pouco envergonhada.
sentences.en: "Grandma, I've become vegan," she said, a little embarrassed.

sentences.pt: A avó olhou para ela como se não tivesse entendido nenhuma palavra.
sentences.en: Her grandmother looked at her as if she hadn't understood a single word.

sentences.pt: "Mas feijão sem carne não tem sabor nenhum, minha filha."
sentences.en: "But beans without meat have no flavor at all, my dear."

sentences.pt: Beatriz já esperava essa resposta e tinha pensado numa saída.
sentences.en: Beatriz was already expecting that answer and had thought of a way out.

sentences.pt: "E se a gente fizesse duas panelas? Uma do jeito da senhora e outra do meu jeito."
sentences.en: "What if we made two pots? One your way and one my way."

sentences.pt: A avó ficou desconfiada, mas a vontade de provar algo novo foi mais forte do que o orgulho.
sentences.en: Her grandmother was suspicious, but the wish to try something new was stronger than pride.

sentences.pt: Na véspera do almoço, as duas passaram a tarde inteira na cozinha.
sentences.en: On the eve of the lunch, the two of them spent the whole afternoon in the kitchen.

sentences.pt: A avó deixou o feijão de molho, cortou a carne e refogou o alho no azeite.
sentences.en: Grandma soaked the beans, cut the meat and sautéed the garlic in olive oil.

sentences.pt: Beatriz, ao lado, ralou cenoura, picou cebola e tomate e grelhou legumes com pimenta.
sentences.en: Beatriz, beside her, grated carrots, chopped onions and tomatoes and grilled vegetables with pepper.

sentences.pt: "Isso aí vai ficar insosso", disse a avó, sem acreditar muito.
sentences.en: "That's going to be bland," grandma said, not really believing in it.

sentences.pt: "Por isso preciso da sua ajuda com o tempero", respondeu Beatriz, sorrindo.
sentences.en: "That's why I need your help with the seasoning," Beatriz answered, smiling.

sentences.pt: A avó não conseguiu ficar quieta: provou o caldo, pediu mais sal, um pouco de pimenta e uma folha verde do jardim.
sentences.en: Grandma couldn't keep quiet: she tasted the broth, asked for more salt, a little pepper and a green leaf from the garden.

sentences.pt: Enquanto cozinhavam, conversaram sobre saúde, sobre o planeta e sobre a infância da avó no interior.
sentences.en: While they cooked, they talked about health, about the planet and about grandma's childhood in the countryside.

sentences.pt: Beatriz explicou que o feijão tem bastante proteína e que o arroz integral tem mais nutrientes.
sentences.en: Beatriz explained that beans have plenty of protein and that brown rice has more nutrients.

sentences.pt: A avó, por sua vez, contou que, na época dela, carne era coisa de domingo, porque era cara.
sentences.en: Grandma, in turn, said that, in her day, meat was a Sunday thing, because it was expensive.

sentences.pt: "No fundo, a gente comia quase como você come agora", disse ela, rindo.
sentences.en: "Deep down, we ate almost the way you eat now," she said, laughing.

sentences.pt: No dia seguinte, as duas panelas foram para a mesa, uma ao lado da outra.
sentences.en: The next day, the two pots went to the table, side by side.

sentences.pt: Para a surpresa de todos, a panela vegana acabou primeiro.
sentences.en: To everyone's surprise, the vegan pot ran out first.

sentences.pt: Os primos mais jovens disseram que estava mais suculento do que esperavam.
sentences.en: The younger cousins said it was juicier than they had expected.

sentences.pt: Até o tio Paulo, que adora um prato de carne, repetiu duas vezes.
sentences.en: Even Uncle Paulo, who loves a meat dish, had seconds twice.

sentences.pt: A avó disse que estava chateada, mas pediu a Beatriz que escrevesse a receita num caderno.
sentences.en: Grandma said she was upset, but asked Beatriz to write the recipe down in a notebook.

sentences.pt: "No ano que vem, a gente faz as duas de novo", disse ela. "Mas o tempero continua sendo meu."
sentences.en: "Next year, we'll make both again," she said. "But the seasoning is still mine."

questions.q: Qual era a notícia de Beatriz?
O que a avó achou do feijão vegano no começo?
questions.qEn: What did grandma think of the vegan beans at first?
